title: Your vision first
description: I design for you, not for my portfolio. A beautiful room that doesn't fit how you actually live isn't a success, it's just expensive.

title: Spaces that last
description: Trends fade; well-chosen design doesn't. I prioritize pieces that feel right five years from now, not just five minutes after they're photographed.

title: The details matter
description: Every throw pillow has a reason. The details are what separate a good room from one you can't stop thinking about.
